body:
## Problem

The Initiatives page has no header or rows.

**Design:** console/design/images/screens/desktop/initiatives.png

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The page header renders the title and the initiative count.
- [ ] Each initiative renders as a row with its name, owner and status pill.

## Problem

Status has no color.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Each status pill renders in its status color.

## Problem

The page reads no live data.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The rows render from the initiatives query.
